item.title: Javascript in Action
item.description: Ever wondered what actually happens when JavaScript runs in a browser? I used to think JavaScript just magically changed things on the screen, but it turns out… the browser gives us two distinct bridges to control everything: BOM and DOM. Just dumping this down as a study archive before I forget how they work. Feel free to follow along if you’re exploring the basics too! :) Let’s break them down one by one, nice and simple.
